content_sections.heading: About PMH Visva-Bharati
content_sections.text: Pearson Memorial Hospital is the hospital of Visva-Bharati at Santiniketan, in Birbhum district, West Bengal (PIN-731235). The Chief Medical Officer runs it, and this recruitment is handled by that office.

content_sections.heading: PMH Visva-Bharati Radiologist Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens. The notice says people living in West Bengal are preferred. No Dearness Allowance is paid. Other allowances such as HRA and TA are also not paid, and neither are benefits such as LTC or leave encashment. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: PMH Visva-Bharati Radiologist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Not exceeding 45 years. Essential qualifications (mandatory): MBBS from any recognised university. MD in Radio Diagnosis or equivalent from any recognised medical institute. Permanent registration with the West Bengal Medical Council. Desirable (preferred, not mandatory): At least one (01) year of experience after passing the MD or equivalent examination. For the full eligibility conditions for the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be shortlisted. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, and the call will be sent to the email ID given in the application. The Competent Authority will not accept any further claim for an interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contract period: The engagement is purely on contract. It starts with six months from the date of joining or lasts until a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. Extension: The contract may be extended from time to time if the Authority is satisfied with the candidate's service and no permanent candidate has filled the post. Termination: Either side may end the contract at any time by giving at least 15 days' notice. Working hours: The post is part-time: one session of 03 (three) hours a day, 06 (six) days a week. Duties: As assigned by the Authority. No claim to a regular post: The contract employee has no claim or right to regular engagement in any post at Visva-Bharati. No regular-employee benefits: There is no Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance treatment, seniority or promotion. Other benefits given to regular Government servants also do not apply.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PMH Visva-Bharati Radiologist Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and print the Annexure-I application form, "Application for the post of Radiologist (Purely Temporary on Part time Contractual basis)". Fill in your name in block letters, your father's or husband's name, date of birth and age, sex, and your permanent and correspondence addresses with PIN codes. Also give your telephone or mobile number and your email ID. Enter the percentage of marks you got in Madhyamik or equivalent, HS/10+2 or equivalent, MBBS and MD or equivalent. Also enter your West Bengal Medical Council registration number and your experience. Paste a self-attested, passport-size colour photograph in the box on the form. Sign the declaration and add the place and date. Send the application to: Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Pearson Memorial Hospital, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, Birbhum, PIN-731235. It must reach the office before 5:00 p.m. on 20 November 2026. Documents to attach (self-attested): Aadhaar card, as proof of your name and your father's or husband's name Proof of date of birth and age, preferably a Birth Registration Certificate Educational certificates: Madhyamik, HS/10+2, MBBS and MD or equivalent West Bengal Medical Council registration certificate Proof of experience Under the declaration on the form, your candidature or engagement may be cancelled or ended without notice if any information is found to be false or incorrect, or if you are found ineligible at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many Radiologist posts are vacant at Pearson Memorial Hospital?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) Radiologist post, filled on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly pay for the Radiologist?
faq.answer: It is a consolidated remuneration or consultation fee of Rs. 75,000/- per month. No DA, HRA, TA or other allowances are paid on top of it.

faq.question: Q3. Is this a full-time job?
faq.answer: No. The Radiologist works part-time, in one session of 3 hours a day, 6 days a week.

faq.question: Q4. Where do I send the application?
faq.answer: Send it to the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Pearson Memorial Hospital, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, Birbhum, PIN-731235. It must reach the office before 5:00 p.m. on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Which medical registration do I need?
faq.answer: You need permanent registration with the West Bengal Medical Council. Attach a self-attested copy of it to the application.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience required?
faq.answer: Experience is not mandatory. One year of experience after passing the MD or equivalent examination is listed as desirable.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first contract is for six months from the date of joining, or until a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. It may be extended if the Authority is satisfied with your service and the post has not been filled permanently.

faq.question: Q8. How will I know if I am called for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview through the email ID they give in item 8 of the application form.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside West Bengal apply?
faq.answer: Any Indian citizen can apply. The notice says those living in West Bengal are preferred, and permanent registration with the West Bengal Medical Council is mandatory.
